latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Episodic Memory Debugger skill for AI memory system analysis and diagnostics.

- Analyze recall precision, recall, F1, and identify low-precision queries
- Detect issues in multi-modal encoding, embedding quality, and cross-modal alignment
- Check indexing efficiency, structure, and duplication in memory indices
- Discover patterns in irrelevant recall by modality, time, and source
- Generate comprehensive diagnostic reports with health scores and actionable recommendations
- Includes tools and classes for recall analysis, encoding validation, index checks, irrelevant recall detection, and memory drift analysis
